// diagnostic

L0516

The default HTTP body text limit is passed through a lower-level body call

What

The default HTTP body text limit is passed through a lower-level body call

Why

Request.text() and response.text() already use the same default cap as body().text(limit)

Fix

Replace body().text(default_limit) with text()

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0516: tests/ui_lint/message_text.warn.

Warning [L0516] (message_text): The default HTTP body text limit is passed through a lower-level body call
  --> tests/ui_lint/message_text.jet:2:24
    |
  2 |     body :: req.body().text(1048576) ?? "fallback"
    |                        ^^^^
 Why: Request.text() and response.text() already use the same default cap as body().text(limit)
 Fix: Replace body().text(default_limit) with text()
